roleLabel: Zone-control Mystic — Blizzard for Frost damage plus team Shields
bestFor: Control boards that want a long fight, Frost stacks, and a Mystic who also peels with Shields
strength: Blizzard taxes everyone standing in the zone every second while shielding allies inside — rare dual offense/defense cast
weakness: Needs Mana Regen / cast uptime and a board that keeps enemies in the storm; short burst fights undersell him

howToPlay.early: Pick Gustav when you can protect a back-mid caster. He is not your first-contact tank. Buy Mana Regen before greed Magic.
howToPlay.mid: Choose the economy: Investor (Shard/Mana Regen investment), Glacier (self-centered Blizzard + Defense scaling), or Avalanche (cast → Shard → Mana Regen/Magic). Match relics to that branch.
howToPlay.late: Keep Blizzard uptime high. Stall paths love Glacier; Shard engines love Avalanche/Investor. Do not starve him of casts.
howToPlay.positioning: Back-mid so the Blizzard covers the main fight lane. Allies who stand in the storm get Shields — clump intentionally, not randomly.

abilityNotes.Blizzard: Win condition is zone uptime. If enemies leave the storm, you paid for a weak DoT. Place the fight so packs walk through it.

specNotes.The Investor: Economy/support path — spend Shards to invest Mana Regen into the team. Take when you are greedy for long-run scaling, not immediate clear.
specNotes.The Glacier: Selfish tank-Mystic hybrid: Blizzard sticks to Gustav and Stall grows Defense. Take when he is your peel anchor.
specNotes.The Avalanche: Cast engine: more Shards and Mana Regen/Magic on generation. Take when you can spam Blizzard every fight.

relicReasons.mystics-barrier-banner-585: Keeps the Mystic Shield fantasy online while Blizzard peels allies in the zone.
relicReasons.mystics-prosperity-filigree-3012: Mana/economy style Mystic piece — helps cast frequency.
relicReasons.arcane-amplifier-2014: Fallback Magic amp when class-specific relics are missing.

faq.question: Is Gustav good in Guildrun?
faq.answer: Excellent on control / Stall / Shield boards. Bad if you need an early pure damage carry and cannot keep enemies in Blizzard.

faq.question: What class is Gustav?
faq.answer: Mystic. Role focus: zone-control Frost caster who also shields heroes inside Blizzard.

faq.question: What relics work with Gustav?
faq.answer: Mystic Barrier / Prosperity pieces, Arcane amplifiers, and Stall tools if you took Glacier.

faq.question: How do you play Gustav?
faq.answer: Stack Mana Regen, drop Blizzard on the main lane, stand allies in the storm for Shields, and specialize toward either peel (Glacier) or cast economy (Avalanche/Investor).

tips: If packs kite out of Blizzard, reposition Gustav or your tank — do not only buy Magic.
Investor is a run plan, not a panic button; take it when Shard spending is already comfortable.
